# Cup N Saucer

> Cup N Saucer is a business growth consultancy based in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India, helping companies build strategy, sales systems, marketing, operations, and organizational capability to turn vision into sustainable, structured growth.

Cup N Saucer works with founders and leadership teams on business strategy, sales and distribution excellence, organizational development, marketing and customer growth, operational systems, and AI & digital transformation. Engagements are practical and outcome-driven rather than theoretical.
